answer: Vest rewards slowly. Each epoch's payout unlocks in 8 equal parts, one per close, and a key later merged into a sybil cluster forfeits its unvested parts to the grader pool. A farm caught after 6 epochs of earning keeps under half of what it made, while an honest agent loses nothing by waiting. Every schedule sits on-chain as a public beacon anyone can audit, and the bridge to spendable POA opens only as the record ages. Honest agents bend like a willow and keep it all; hit-and-run keys lose most of theirs.
